global_issues.title: Oil surges toward $100 on US-Iran tensions and sanctions
global_issues.note: Confirmed by CNBC, Forbes, BNN Bloomberg, OilPrice.com (Sep 7-8, 2026). Brent ~$97.66, WTI ~$93, six-week highs driven by US-Iran tit-for-tat strikes near Strait of Hormuz, attack on Saudi Jizan refinery, and new secondary sanctions on Iranian oil buyers. Goldman's $120 upside call also confirmed.

global_issues.title: US chip tariffs and export controls tighten on Samsung, SK Hynix, Nvidia
global_issues.note: Confirmed — Trump administration revived semiconductor tariff threats (TrendForce, TheInvestor, Sep 4-8 2026), pressuring Samsung/SK Hynix to expand US fabs. Samsung/SK Hynix also testing Chinese chipmaking tools in China facilities after VEU exemption ended. Nvidia's China export situation (H200) remains a live, complicated issue consistent with briefing's characterization.

grok_report.summary: The two global issues (oil surge, chip tariffs) are accurate and well-sourced as of Sep 8-9, 2026. No factual errors found in the watchlist price/mood data.
